title: [テーブル設計][書いてみよう] 外部キーを持つ employees テーブルを作成する
statement: 部署と社員を保存する departments, employees テーブルを作成してください。departments は id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL。employees は id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, hired_at TEXT NOT NULL とします。department_id から departments(id) への外部キーも設定してください。

constraints.name: 作成するテーブル
constraints.value: departments と employees の2つを作成します

constraints.name: 外部キー
constraints.value: employees.department_id は departments.id を参照します

constraints.name: 必須列
constraints.value: 各テーブルの name と employees の department_id, hired_at は NOT NULL にします

checkSql: SELECT 'column' AS check_type, m.name AS table_name, p.name AS item_name, UPPER(p.type) AS detail, p."notnull" AS required, p.pk AS key_order FROM sqlite_master AS m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) AS p WHERE m.type = 'table' AND m.name IN ('departments', 'employees') UNION ALL SELECT 'foreign_key' AS check_type, m.name AS table_name, f."from" AS item_name, f."table" || '.' || f."to" AS detail, '' AS required, '' AS key_order FROM sqlite_master AS m JOIN pragma_foreign_key_list(m.name) AS f WHERE m.type = 'table' AND m.name IN ('departments', 'employees') ORDER BY check_type, table_name, item_name;
